cat > /workdir/analyze.py <<'PY'
import socket,time,sys,chess

def send(c):s.sendall((c+'\n').encode())
send('uci')

 l=f.readline().strip()
 if l=='uciok':break
send('setoption name Threads value 4')
send('setoption name Hash value 256')
send('setoption name MultiPV value '+(sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else '1'))
send('isready')
while f.readline().strip()!='readyok':pass
send('position startpos moves '+' '.join(m.uci() for m in b.move_stack))
send('go movetime '+str(int(float(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 30)*1000)))
last={}
while True:
 l=f.readline().strip()
 if not l:break
 if l.startswith('info depth') and ' pv ' in l:
  p=l.split();last[p[p.index('multipv')+1] if 'multipv' in p else '1']=l
 if l.startswith('bestmove'):
  for x in last.values():print(x)
  print(l);break
send('quit')
